scheduler_registration.reason: Joe has requested recurring execution but has not selected a reminder/build cadence. A SKILL definition alone is not a scheduler registration.
activation_requires: a scheduler-side registration readback showing the exact task, cadence, and enabled state
an OS/runtime principal or equivalent deployment boundary for the unattended runner
a canary proving the scheduler identity is bound to the runner before any tool is exposed

reminder.semantics: When enabled, remind Joe only about the sole current queue item until independently verified completion. Completion causes the next ordinal to become the sole reminder target.

completion_authority: A separate interactive owner decision plus independent verifier evidence; the recurring builder cannot call complete-capability-project.
current_activation_scope: reminder_only_pending_runner_identity; autonomous build preparation is not enabled
